title: tn14: Self-Consistency Fixed-Point Equation for mu(x)

constraints_on_delta_rho.R1_sign_flip: Must be positive for deep MOND (low y), negative for Newtonian (high y)
constraints_on_delta_rho.R2_localization: Must be localized near omega ~ omega_c
constraints_on_delta_rho.R3_amplitude: Must match C_eq at crossover scale y ~ 1/C_eq
constraints_on_delta_rho.R4_scale_dep: delta_rho must depend on the dynamical state y = g_bar/a_0

interpretation.fixed_point_nature: Underdetermined inverse problem — infinitely many delta_rho satisfy the constraint
interpretation.stieltjes_KK_failure: Both fail because they are equilibrium transforms; NESS requires dynamical chain
interpretation.next_step: tn15: physical NESS equation selects unique delta_rho from backreaction
